channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Entidades apontam novos indícios de tratamento desigual da Meta a Lula e Flávio no TSE
item.description: Sleeping Giants Brasil and CTRL+Z submitted new evidence to the TSE, suggesting possible unequal treatment by Meta toward the campaigns of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. The organizations are requesting an investigation into potential bias in ad policies.

item.title: Governo antecipa pagamento de Bolsa Família reajustado para antes do 2º turno
item.description: The Lula administration advanced the 15%-adjusted Bolsa Família payment to before the presidential runoff. This social program benefit targets all recipients ahead of the contest between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL).

item.title: TSE dá 24 horas para Meta dar informações sobre igualdade de campanhas
item.description: TSE Minister Marco Aurélio Buzzi gave Meta 24 hours to prove it has adopted campaign equality measures on Facebook and Instagram. The decision aims to ensure transparency and fairness in the use of digital resources by candidates and parties. Meta must submit documents proving the practices adopted.

item.title: Deputado André Janones (Rede) é internado em SP com arritmia cardíaca
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) was hospitalized in an ICU in São Paulo with cardiac arrhythmia after attending the Bandeirantes TV presidential debate between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL).

item.title: Após o debate, Lula volta a desafiar Flávio Bolsonaro a abrir sigilos
item.description: Lula challenged Flávio Bolsonaro to open his bank and phone records, proposing a joint asset assessment before the second round. The demand was made during a debate on TV Band and reinforced in a video on the PT leader's social media. Lula also included relatives of both candidates in the proposal.

item.title: Oposição busca assinaturas para criar CPMI para investigar Luchsinger e Lulinha
item.description: Opposition lawmakers Coronel Fernanda (PL-MT) and Damares Alves (Republicanos-DF) are gathering support to establish a CPMI to investigate Fábio Luís Lula da Silva (Lulinha) and businesswoman Roberta Luchsinger over suspicions of influence peddling, corruption, and undue favors. The request seeks to deepen investigations into alleged corrupt acts involving figures close to former president Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. The main focus lies on political and partisan investigations within the 2026 pre-election context.

item.title: Com Janones na UTI, “Exército do Lula” está há 12 horas sem atualizações
item.description: The WhatsApp channel 'Army of Lula', with over 5.4 million subscribers, went offline after lawmaker André Janones (Rede-MG) was hospitalized in the ICU for cardiac arrhythmia. The group, managed by Janones, has become the subject of legal disputes at the TSE regarding its status as an official campaign channel.

item.title: PSol acusa Ricardo Nunes de assédio eleitoral e coação no MPT e no MPE
item.description: Federal deputy Luciene Cavalcante (PSol-SP) filed complaints with the MPT and MPE against São Paulo mayor Ricardo Nunes (MDB) and senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), accusing them of electoral harassment and abuse of power. The complaint stems from an alleged mobilization of civil servants and sub-mayors for the 'Bloquinho do 22', a pro-Bolsonaro rally on Paulista Avenue.

item.title: Pesquisa PoderData/Aya: Flávio Bolsonaro lidera em quatro regiões e Lula vence em uma
item.description: The PoderData/Aya survey shows Flávio Bolsonaro ahead of Lula in four of the five regions, with his largest lead in the South. Lula leads only in the Northeast and is nearly tied in the North.

item.title: Adesivo de Lula e número de Flávio Bolsonaro circulam juntos em Mercedes
item.description: Stickers of Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro were found together on a pickup truck parked in Pirenópolis, Goiás, during the election runoff. The pairing of political figures on a single vehicle raises suspicions about potentially questionable electoral practices.

item.title: PF faz operação contra ex-servidor do STJ suspeito de vazar informações a advogado aliado de Flávio
item.description: The Federal Police launched an operation against Humberto Pradera, former IT secretary at STJ, accused of leaking confidential information to lawyer Willer Tomaz, an ally of Flávio Bolsonaro. Led by the Supreme Court, the investigation probes charges including breach of secrecy, corruption, and money laundering, involving Senator Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: O custo aos cofres públicos da tarifa zero em feriados e finais de semana prometida por Lula
item.description: Lula's promise of free public transport on weekends and holidays would cost an estimated R$20.8 billion annually, according to NTU. While it may boost demand by 20%, it fails to address structural funding issues, requiring greater federal involvement.

item.title: Três histórias por trás das perguntas de Lula a Flávio sobre mulheres
item.description: In the Band debate, Lula questioned Flávio Bolsonaro about votes and stances opposing women's rights, such as maternity leave and equal pay, without receiving direct answers. He also raised the case of a child killed by police, questioning Flávio's role as lawyer. The accusations aim to highlight Flávio's more conservative stance on gender and justice issues.

item.title: O conjunto híbrido de 111 cv dispensa a necessidade de carregar na tomada e permite escolher entre modos de condução econômico, normal e elétrico em um SUV compacto
item.description: The 2026 Toyota Yaris Cross Hybrid, manufactured in Brazil, combines a flexible hybrid engine with 111 hp and an e-CVT transmission, offering three driving modes: economy, normal, and electric. The vehicle eliminates the need for wall chargers, making it ideal for reducing fuel consumption in urban traffic.

item.title: Deputada eleita aciona TRE-RJ e cobra 'campanha massiva' para divulgar locais de votação no segundo turno
item.description: Elected federal deputy Anielle Franco (PT-RJ) filed a request with the TRE-RJ for a mass campaign to publicize changes in voting locations before the second round of the 2026 elections, following over 4,300 polling stations having their addresses altered due to factors such as heavy rains and unfinished school renovations. In a formal letter, she asks for communication via radio, TV, SMS, WhatsApp, and e-Título notifications, highlighting the risk of voters going to the old location and losing their votes.

item.title: As perguntas que ficaram sem resposta no primeiro debate entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula
item.description: The first debate between Flávio Bolsonaro and Lula was marked by accusations and lack of proposals, with several unanswered questions. Topics such as maternity leave, INSS investigations and the Daniel Vorcaro case were addressed polemically. Flávio was accused of dodging more issues, while Lula was questioned about parallel investigations.

item.title: Homem que atropelou manifestante em ato pró-Lula em BH é solto sem fiança
item.description: A man detained for running over a pro-Lula protester in BH was released without bail. The judge deemed the arrest valid but granted provisional freedom, citing no prior records and attempted homicide charges. Witnesses and the driver's family disagreed on the intent behind the incident.

item.title: Quem é Marcelo Aguiar, deputado estadual detido após disparo de arma em casa noturna de São Paulo
item.description: State deputy Marcelo Aguiar (PL), 53, was detained early Monday morning following a gunshot at a nightclub in São Paulo's Itaim Bibi district. He was released after giving statements due to parliamentary immunity. His background includes an artistic career, evangelical ties, and service in the Municipal City Council, Chamber of Deputies, and São Paulo State Legislature.

item.title: Mais ricos apostam em volta dos Bolsonaro à Presidência do país, aponta PoderData/Aya
item.description: A PoderData/Aya survey shows that 57% of Brazilians earning more than five minimum wages believe Flávio Bolsonaro is more likely to win the 2026 election, against 38% who see Lula as the probable winner; meanwhile, 55% disapprove of Lula's performance in this income group.

item.title: Flávio tem 50,4% dos votos válidos contra 49,6% de Lula, diz pesquisa
item.description: A poll by Futura/100% Cidades released on October 19, 2026, shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) leading with 50.4% of valid votes against Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT)'s 49.6% in the second round, indicating a very close race. Lula's rejection rate is 47.4%, slightly above Flávio's 45.8%, according to the same survey. The poll interviewed 2,000 voters between October 16 and 17, with a margin of error of 2.2 percentage points and a 95% confidence level.

item.title: A verdadeira vantagem para Flávio no debate da Band
item.description: The Band electoral debate provided strategic advantage to Flávio Bolsonaro, positioning him as a key figure in the 2026 presidential race. Post-debate analysis is challenging due to polarization and selective use of clips on social media.

item.title: ‘Final Fantasy VII Revelation’ investe em combates mais versáteis; testamos
item.description: Final Fantasy VII Revelation, the third and final episode of the reimagining of the 90s classic, offers more versatile battles with new playable characters like Cid and Vincent, plus the innovative VISU system allowing the incorporation of skills from different warrior classes. Tested at Brasil Game Show 2026, the game showcases impressive technological advances and an expansion of the mythology around iconic characters like Cloud and Sephiroth.

item.title: Janones é internado em UTI depois de arritmia cardíaca
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) was hospitalized in ICU after experiencing cardiac arrhythmia during the presidential debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonauro. The information was confirmed by Dr. Ludhmila Hajjar, who stated he is in good condition. During the debate, Janones mobilized supporters to promote negative searches about Flávio Bolsonaro on Google.

item.title: A resposta do Senado ao STF sobre a não instalação de CPI sobre Master e ministros
item.description: The Senate told the STF that not installing a CPI on Banco Master and ministers was not illegal omission, as the presidency must assess constitutional requirements. The request was filed by Senator Alessandro Vieira.

item.title: Quem tem prioridade na fila de votação no segundo turno?
item.description: In the 2026 runoff election, certain voters will have voting priority, including those over 80 years old, people with disabilities, pregnant women, and infants, among others. The rule generally follows the order of arrival at the polling station, but individuals over 80 maintain priority regardless of arrival time. Blood donors are also granted priority upon presentation of proof.

item.title: Pesquisa Futura, que se aproximou do resultado no 1º turno, mostra empate entre Flávio Bolsonaro e Lula
item.description: A survey by the Futura institute shows a technical tie between Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the second round of the 2026 presidential elections, with 50.4% and 49.6% of valid votes, respectively. The margin of error of 2.2 points makes the result a tie. The survey was conducted between October 16 and 17, before the Band debate. The institute stood out for closely matching the first-round results.

item.title: André Janones é internado na UTI de hospital em SP após debate na Band
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) was hospitalized in the ICU of Hospital Vila Nova Star in São Paulo after a severe heart arrhythmia, following the presidential debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro on Band TV. His team confirmed he is under the care of cardiologist Ludhmila Hajjar, with a detailed health update expected at 1 PM. The previous night, Janones commented on the debate via social media, criticizing Flávio's stance and praising Lula's performance.

item.title: Janones é internado em UTI com arritmia cardíaca após debate entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Federal deputy André Janones (Rede-MG) was hospitalized in the ICU with cardiac arrhythmia after the debate between Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) on Sunday night (18). He was admitted to Hospital Vila Nova Star in São Paulo early Monday morning (19). His hospitalization takes place amid intense electoral debates ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Quando será o segundo turno das Eleições 2026? Veja data
item.description: The 2026 Brazilian runoff election is scheduled for October 25, featuring Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) as presidential candidates. The runoff applies exclusively to Executive positions when no candidate reaches absolute majority in the first round.

item.title: Guia Eleições 2026: confira o que levar, horário, local e ordem de votação e como justificar o voto
item.description: O GLOBO published an electoral guide for the 2026 elections, detailing required documents, voting time and location for the second round (October 25), voting order, and how to justify a vote. Voters must bring a photo ID such as e-Título, ID card, or driver's license, and can check polling stations via the TSE website or e-Título app.

item.title: Segundo turno para governador será realizado em cinco Estados e no DF neste domingo
item.description: 2026 elections feature a gubernatorial runoff in five states and the Federal District, with the presidential race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro. Voting determines both president and governor in those six jurisdictions, while other states elect only the president.

item.title: A maioria que o eleitor não escolheu: votos anulados e o 2º turno no RJ
item.description: The Superior Electoral Court (TSE) nullified Anthony Garotinho's votes (Republicanos) and recalculated the absolute majority without a second round in the Rio de Janeiro election. Douglas Ruas (PL) increased from 49.27% to 50.88% without gaining votes, while Eduardo Paes (PSD) remained at 42.76%. The ruling relied on the distinction between inherently null votes and those annulled by judicial action.

item.title: Bolsa Família reajustado começa a ser pago nesta 2ª feira
item.description: The federal government adjusted the Bolsa Família benefit by 15.04%, raising the minimum from R$ 600 to R$ 691 and the average benefit from R$ 675 to R$ 777. The budget cost will be R$ 5.8 billion in 2026 and R$ 22 billion in 2027, with adjustments included in the budget proposal. The measure was announced 17 days before the first round of elections, but the government denies electoral intent.

item.title: Debate virou uma luta livre, e eleitorado entrou com a cara
item.description: The debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro devolved into a schoolyard fight, marked by verbal aggressions and aggressive posture. The electorate was impacted by the intensity of the confrontation, which exceeded expectations. Polarization intensified with exchanges of insults and personal attacks.

item.title: PM é acionada durante debate e descarta suspeita de bomba em carro na Band
item.description: The PM was called during a debate between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) to investigate a bomb threat in a car parked at Band's lot. After inspection, police ruled out any risk. The incident did not disrupt the debate.

item.title: Presos podem votar? Entenda regra citada no debate entre Flávio e Lula
item.description: The right to vote for imprisoned individuals was discussed in the debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, highlighting disagreements on electoral rules. The Brazilian Constitution allows voting for defendants in process but not for those convicted with imprisonment sentences.

item.title: Decepcionante, triste, vergonhoso, infeliz: como eleitores analisaram o debate entre Flávio e Lula
item.description: Voters in a qualitative research group deemed the debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro disappointing, sad, and shameful, highlighting a lack of proposals and low discussion quality. Most participants, regardless of their vote, criticized the absence of relevant issues and the confrontational tone that discouraged voters. Lula was seen as repetitive and demagogic, while Flávio was judged empty and overly aggressive.

item.title: Quem ganhou e quem perdeu no primeiro debate entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: The first debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro on Band was marked by direct attacks and a lack of proposals, leaving independent voters dissatisfied. Analysts believe the confrontation will not significantly influence voting decisions and may even encourage abstention or blank and null votes.

item.title: Arrogância e nervosismo em um ‘circo dos horrores’: colunistas avaliam debate entre Flávio e Lula
item.description: The first debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro was marked by accusations and tense audience behavior, with no major policy proposals. Columnists highlighted Flávio's arrogant posture, describing the event as a 'circus of horrors', with no clear winner.

item.title: Primeiro debate entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro tem troca de acusações e poucas propostas
item.description: The first debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro was marked by mutual attacks and few proposals, with emphasis on corruption accusations. Both addressed public security and debt, but prioritized criticism over concrete solutions.

item.title: Padilha rebate Flávio sobre pandemia e hospitais do Rio
item.description: Minister of Health Alexandre Padilha criticized Flávio Bolsonaro's management in the health sector, warning of risks similar to those at Rio's federal hospitals. During the Band debate, Flávio acknowledged failures during the pandemic but denied corruption charges and illegal fees. Padilha highlighted suspicions of over R$100 million in embezzlement and unlicensed contracts.

item.title: Nikolas critica modelo de debate da “Band”: “Não é eficaz”
item.description: Deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) criticized the open format of the Band's presidential debate, deeming it 'not effective'. He noted that Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) appeared 'calm' and discussed proposals, whereas President Lula (PT) seemed 'nervous' but more aggressive. The debate, moderated by Adriana Araújo and Eduardo Oinegue, marked the first direct confrontation between the two candidates in the runoff.

item.title: Nikolas zoa Haddad e Tebet na “Band”: “Estão desempregados”
item.description: Federal deputy Nikolas Ferreira (PL-MG) mocked Fernando Haddad and Simone Tebet after the Band presidential debate, calling them unemployed for losing the 2026 elections. Haddad and Tebet did not respond to the provocations. The debate marked the first direct confrontation between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro in the runoff.

item.title: Lula chama Dani Marques de “mulher da economia”, e direita vê machismo
item.description: During the Band debate, Lula referred to Daniella Marques as 'the economy woman,' which Flávio Bolsonaro and allies viewed as a sexist remark. Daniella responded that the comment was misogynistic and emphasized her professional trajectory, rejecting being reduced in her role in the campaign.

item.title: Pesquisa do PT avalia que debate não deve mudar votos de indecisos
item.description: A qualitative survey commissioned by the PT shows that the Band debate between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro did not change the voting intentions of undecided voters, despite Lula being rated better. Most participants prefer debates focused on proposals rather than attacks, highlighting issues such as cost of living, SUS, and prices.

item.title: Las claves del primer debate en Brasil: un Lula tecnócrata ante un Bolsonaro provocador
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro debated in São Paulo in a forum organized by Band and Estadão. Bolsonaro attacked from the start, while Lula was more technical and focused on economy and international alliances.

item.title: Ato pró-Flávio tem míssil inflável pedindo ataque de Trump
item.description: At a Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) rally in São Paulo, protesters carried an inflatable missile labeled 'Trump nuke Brazil', calling for a nuclear strike by U.S. President Donald Trump against Brazil. The incident sparked social media reactions and criticism from President Lula (PT), who deemed the act treasonous and questioned Eduardo Bolsonaro's ties to the U.S.

item.title: Gate descarta bomba em carro da comitiva de Flávio Bolsonaro no debate
item.description: The São Paulo Military Police's Special Tactical Actions Group (GATE) dismissed the bomb hypothesis in a vehicle from Flávio Bolsonaro's entourage during a debate on the evening of the 18th. The alert, reported by Senate police, involved detection dogs identifying chemical components, but ammonia, commonly found in airbags, was later confirmed as the substance. Both candidates, Flávio and Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, left the venue without incident.

item.title: Quando será o debate presidencial da Globo? Veja a data e o horário
item.description: The TV Globo presidential debate between Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) will take place on October 23rd, immediately after the Jornal Nacional, broadcast live and moderated by César Tralli. The event will be simultaneously streamed on TV Globo, GloboNews, and digital platforms such as g1 and Globoplay.

item.title: O ‘troco’ de Lula em Flávio sobre o voto de Jair Bolsonaro
item.description: In a presidential debate, Lula taunted Flávio Bolsonaro by suggesting he convince his father, Jair Bolsonaro jailed for far-right coup plotting, to vote for him. The face-off highlighted corruption allegations and scandals involving both candidates. Polls show a technical tie ahead of the runoff.
